scripts.build:richtext: esbuild static/js/richtext_editor_source.js --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --minify --outfile=static/js/richtext_editor.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p='static/js/richtext_editor.js';let s=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');const b='renderMarkdown:()=>'+String.fromCharCode(96)+'  \n'+String.fromCharCode(96),a='renderMarkdown:()=>'+JSON.stringify('  \n');if(!s.includes(b))throw new Error('Expected hard-break template literal not found');fs.writeFileSync(p,s.replace(b,a));"
